behavior_rules.condition: active listen-only + observed advise + unnecessary advice + ruled-out exception + sufficient evidence
observed claim + complete authoritative fixture trace + no verified human ACK

fixture_safety_rule.note: Simulation of evidence plumbing ONLY; not safety review, calibration or human adjudication.

blocks.reason: Authoritative safety/privacy version and qualified reviewer not supplied.
Baseline Q1/Q4/Q5/Q6 anchors not available; do not invent them.

interaction_refinements.authority: Product owner requested integrating student perspective and rhetorical-vs-real-request pairs in the same offline PR.
decisions: Communicative purpose is inferred from prefix, not the phrase em phải làm sao or punctuation alone.
Venting does not silently revoke an active listen-only boundary; clear request changes can.
Whole-turn reflection without help for a clear solution request scores Q2=0 under the existing anchor; permission loops may score 1.
No-questions includes questions embedding advice; it does not by itself imply advice is wanted.
Q3 evaluates respectful age-appropriate tone without slang quotas; complete persona acceptance requires a separate reviewed case set.

persona_design.direction: Linh hoạt bốn nét theo bối cảnh: tinh tế vui tính nhẹ nhàng; lém lỉnh tinh nghịch; dịu dàng ấm áp; năng động nhiệt huyết. Không quá trung lập hoặc nhồi slang.
